as_told.title: Eric Davis says the program had almost no theoretical physicists

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon studies of UFOs, is said to have described a secret programme with craft that "defy the laws of physics" but no physicists working on them. The mathematician Eric Weinstein repeats this as Davis's words. Michels repeats it twice in other episodes, once just saying there were no physicists on the programme, and once telling it as Davis's answer when asked directly whether any theoretical physicists were involved: "there none of them were." The point is that the people holding the strangest technology may not have the scientists needed to understand it.
